description: This file defines a class VertexAIFilesHandler that manages file operations with Vertex AI, including uploading files to GCS buckets and downloading file content, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous execution.

classes.name: VertexAIFilesHandler
classes.description: Handles file operations with Vertex AI, including uploading files to GCS and downloading file content, supporting both sync and async methods.

methods.name: async_create_file
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a file in Vertex AI GCS bucket, uploads content, and returns an OpenAIFileObject.

methods.name: create_file
methods.description: Creates a file either asynchronously or synchronously based on _is_async flag.

methods.name: _extract_bucket_and_object_from_file_id
methods.description: Extracts bucket name and object path from a URL-encoded GCS file ID.

methods.name: afile_content
methods.description: Asynchronously downloads file content from GCS bucket and returns it wrapped in HttpxBinaryResponseContent.

methods.name: file_content
methods.description: Downloads file content from GCS, supporting both sync and async operations.
